background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one reusable EMPTY fixed background plate, wide16:9, for CANCEL CITY Copy-Paste Kakashi. The supplied image is ONLY a reference for current card scratchy neon style; no character or props from that image.
Environment: absurd shabby PHOTOCOPY OFFICE that has been converted into a NINJA DOJO. A broad unobstructed green-grey tatami-mat floor with dark seams fills lower half. In the distance along back wall: blank off-white photocopier at back-right, filing cabinets, empty paper shelves, fluorescent office ceiling tubes and a few vertical wooden dojo wall beams. Dark scuffed roller blinds over back window. A blank beige rectangular noticeboard with absolutely no writing. Leave center and left foreground clear for a whole-body actor and a separately composited copier; all permanent office furniture kept well in the far background.
Lighting: acid yellow-green fluorescent ceiling strips, deep magenta shadow walls, dark black ink and dirty teal/grey tatami. Consistent waist-height low perspective, level floor. Dense harsh black scratched etching, crosshatching, gritty stippling, rough cheap-print lurid card texture matching reference. Not clean anime background, smooth paint, vector, photoreal3D or glossy render.
STRICT empty environment: no human, ninja, face, body, clone, scroll, paper roll, floating or moving paper, scattered papers, loose sheets, energy, aura, smoke, steam, lightning, particles. No foreground photocopier blocking actor. One distant background copier only. No text, words, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, labels, frame or watermark. Clean negative-space stage in the foreground.
